notes: Host UI contributions are limited to sidebarPage, playerBarButton, settingsPanel, localSidebarItem, streamingHome.
Plugin host UI command timeout is 5s; the snapshot command only reads the cache and waits at most 3s.

In 1.3.1 ui.notify routes info/warning notices to the task/notification center; only error or action notices become floating toasts.
The plugin never writes outside context.storagePath.
